title: Flight Simulator 2020 - POI - Panama -  Scarlett Martínez International Airport (MPSM)
description:
In this video we will land at Scarlett Martínez International Airport (MPSM). Scarlett Martínez International Airport (IATA: RIH, ICAO: MPSM), also known as Río Hato Airport, is an international airport serving Río Hato, a town in the Coclé Province of Panama. The airport is 3 kilometres (2 mi) east of Río Hato.
